metadata.change_reason: Business sequence and state machine architecture quality standard: Standard Mermaid sequence diagrams, deadlock-free state machines, and concurrency controls

spec.name: Business Sequence & State Machine Quality Standard

rules.statement: All core business flows must provide standard Mermaid sequence diagrams specifying actor roles and step-by-step descriptions across happy, edge, and error paths
Entity state machines must define explicit initial states and terminal state sets, with rigorous transition guards preventing deadlocks
Must explicitly define concurrency locking mechanisms, local/distributed transaction boundaries, and rollback/compensation strategies
